## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY - Maximum 1 guest per competitor**
Please check the [COVID-19 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PaladiamanteOpen2022#16990-covid-19) to understand the safety rules enforced at this competition.
**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PaladiamanteOpen2022/register).**

![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) 
## **MASCHERINE FFP2 OBBLIGATORIE - Massimo 1 accompagnatore per partecipante**
Consulta la [sezione COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PaladiamanteOpen2022#16990-covid-19) per comprendere le norme di sicurezza della competizione.
**Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy.
È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PaladiamanteOpen2022/register).**
